note: corr(z(s), z(s')) = (1 - nugget) * exp(-|s - s'| / ell), s = transformed age in years; nugget = share of z variance that is measurement/short-term noise. 'weight' = z on breed-adjusted charts (used when a breed or adult weight is known); 'category' = z on the size-category charts (used when the chart is fitted to the weigh-ins). Maximum likelihood on dogs with >= 2 weights.
